keyed by check number / trace number

Processor payout file (file only, no API)

STRETCH: undecided scope A-07/H-2

same statement id, new content hash

Consumed events: ar.payment.applied,
ap.payment.scheduled (expect 1:n debits),
close.period.locked

span.p:
Structural validation before content:
field count vs header (F-01), date format (F-02),
merged cells / footer rows (F-12), sign convention
asserted against statement control total (F-04)

span.p:
REFUSE the whole file, not half of it
reason stated, nothing ingested
(F-01, F-02, F-04, F-12)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Idempotent ingest on source_system + source_id (F-05)
statement key (account, period, version_hash)
writes trace(kind=bank_statement) and bank_txn

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Descriptor normalisation: fold whitespace, NBSP,
trailing tabs, case, encoding (F-13)
raw string kept on the trace as evidence

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alias table: fact(predicate=alias)
descriptor variant → stable key
originator_company_id, vendor.id, customer.id

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Resolve party to stable key: originator id →
alias table → else model port A
GUSTO PAYROLL and GUSTO TAX COLLECTION
land on one key (A-09, H-3)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Internal transfer / sweep detection (A-19)
two legs, both own-account ids, equal and opposite,
value dates within 2 days → transfer pair
never touches P and L, cash not double counted

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Zero and negative rows (A-22)
0.00 line is valid data, kept and grouped
no percent division, sign carried explicitly

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Period boundary split (A-23)
split statement lines at cutoff on value date
post-cutoff half goes to the next period only

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queued for the next period only
any attempt to post it into the locked month
→ BLOCK, persisted with rule id (A-23)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Blocking (candidate generation)
same resolved party (plus parent/child), open items
only (bank_txn vs gl_line on cash accounts),
item date lte bank value date

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 0 · carry-forward clear
prior-period outstanding list matched by
check number / trace, date window widened
for THIS list only (A-02, A-16)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 1 · exact 1:1
amount equal in cents + resolved party
+ value date within 3 days (DESIGN window)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 2 · reference 1:1
check number, ACH trace number, EndToEndId,
invoice ref · near-ref Damerau-Levenshtein 1 and
unique → PROPOSE naming the transposition (A-12)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 3 · tolerance, 1:1 ONLY
amount tolerance from an approved policy,
clamped to the class ceiling · NEVER combined
with subset-sum or any group pass

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 4 · fee-delta, 1:1 only (A-03)
same party, book minus bank inside the learned
fee band for that bank / corridor
8,250.00 vs 8,232.50 → match + 17.50 fee line

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 5 · many-to-one bounded subset-sum (A-05)
one payment covering three invoices · same party,
open items, n lte 24, exact cents, meet-in-the-middle
O(2^(n/2)) or DP · hands application to AR

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 6 · one-to-many (A-06)
one book payment run = three bank debits
exact sum, same run id from ap.payment.scheduled

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 7 · processor payout expansion (STRETCH A-07/H-2)
bank line net == sum(net) for one automatic_payout_id
assert sum(gross) - sum(fee) == sum(net) to the cent

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Processor clearing account (STRETCH)
charge: Dr Clearing / Cr AR at gross · payout: Dr Cash
net, Dr Processing fees, Cr Clearing gross
check: clearing balance == not yet paid out

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 8 · duplicate detection
same party + amount, book lines gt bank lines
refund posted twice: second book line has no bank line

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
True duplicate (A-13): same vendor, amount and
invoice ref, 3 days apart, two bank debits
→ bankrec.unmatched debit to AP, obligation-key BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
False duplicate (A-14): same vendor, amount, day
but distinct invoice refs and PO lines
→ two valid 1:1 matches, do not suppress

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 9 · ambiguity check (A-18)
two 4,500.00 debits, same day, different vendors
any second candidate is kept, never dropped

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Uniqueness gate (Fellegi-Sunter three zones)
exactly one candidate → AUTO / PROPOSE eligible
second candidate → ESCALATE, both shown
no candidate → residue (stage 5)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Spec said: every bank line matched exactly once
Replaced by: every bank line AND every ledger cash
line sits in exactly one TYPED GROUP

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
rec group: id, type, bank_txn ids, gl_line ids,
sum_bank_cents, sum_book_cents, pass, statement hash
DESIGN: in workpaper marks_json, schema gap
Proposal.kind lacks reconciling_item

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
match, typed 1:1 · 1:n · n:1 · n:m
1:1 from passes 0-4 (tolerance allowed)
groups from passes 5-7, exact sums only

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
transfer pair (A-19)
both legs cash accounts, net zero, no P and L

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
reconciling_item(timing)
NOT a journal entry, carried forward

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deposit in transit (A-01)
book 30 Sep, bank 2 Oct
adds to bank balance

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Outstanding check (A-02)
check 1042 uncleared at month end
subtracts from bank balance, cleared once next
period, never double counted

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stale check (A-16)
written March, clears September
clears its carried-forward item

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
adjusting_entry
book side is wrong or missing: fee, interest,
bank charge, duplicate book line → JE proposed

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
open_exception
named, aged, owner, places searched
never silently dropped, never plugged

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Carry-forward list for the next period
check number / trace, amount, age
becomes input 1 of the next run

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TWO-SIDED PROOF (code, integer cents)
bank balance + deposits in transit - outstanding checks
== book balance + adjustments
difference must be 0 cents

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Residual classification (code)
book-only before cutoff → timing item
bank-only with bank-originated code (fee, interest)
→ JE · anything else → model port

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Standalone bank charge (A-04)
bank debits 300.00, no book entry
propose Dr Bank charges / Cr Cash

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Abbreviated trading name (A-10)
ACME CLOUD SVCS vs Acme Cloud Services Inc.
→ port A

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Memo describes the spend, not the payee (A-11)
ledger: Q3 conference booth
bank: CASCADE EVENTS LLC · rules leave it alone
→ port B

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Void and reissue (A-17)
check 1042 voided, check 1099 issued, same payee
and amount · recognise void entry, link the pair

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bank error (A-25)
bank posts 4,500 where instruction was 4,050
needs external confirmation, bank query drafted

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The $12.40 difference nobody can explain
port C finds no evidence
everywhere-I-looked list attached

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Materiality gate (code, $500 from kernel P)
immaterial, first occurrence, non-sensitive
→ log, do not queue (D-09) · recurring or in a
sensitive account (cash) → escalate (D-10)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Plug guard: an unexplained difference is never
booked to suspense / rounding without
evidence and approval

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent router: tier 0 compiled policy or fact (no
model call) → tier 1 claude-haiku-4-5 → tier 2
claude-sonnet-5 → tier 3 claude-opus-5
kernel reject escalates one tier

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Port A · entity resolution on hard descriptors
must cite the alias source (prior payment trace,
contract signature block, CRM domain)
may not restate amounts as the reason (G-12)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Port B · no-lexical-overlap match
one bank line + up to 5 code-generated candidates
equal in amount · cites a trace (booth invoice
naming the conference) · none is a valid answer

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Port C · reason-finding for a residual
Investigator: mail.search, chat.search,
bank.get_transaction, memory.similar_decisions
returns a quoted span or REFUSE + places searched

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Model never: adds numbers, picks among
equal-amount or equal-sum candidates,
widens a tolerance, or posts

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Code only: validation, normalise, passes 0-9,
subset-sum, proof arithmetic, cutoff,
materiality, hash compare

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
propose_entry + workpaper
kind = bank_adjustment or no_action
entries Dr/Cr, evidence trace_id + quote, marks F E P J

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
escalate(question)
candidates shown, none picked
names what it does not know

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F · every bank line and every ledger cash line is in
exactly one typed group or a named reconciling item
two-sided proof ties to the cent · payout arithmetic

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
E · every adjusting JE cites its bank line, fee JE
cites the matched pair, quote is substring of trace
J · fee-band policy approved, active on the value
date, scoped to the bank / corridor

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
P · period open (close.period.locked)
rec preparer is not approver
a stale rec cannot be signed

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hard rules: no P and L impact from internal
transfers · one bank line in two groups · plug with
no evidence · post-cutoff half into locked month

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post to local ledger gl_entry / gl_line
→ one-way QuickBooks mirror (JournalEntry)

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controller agent (GPT, different model family)
reviews PROPOSE within its authority

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human in Slack: controller, AP / AR lead
answer → fact candidate with scope

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deposit in transit / outstanding check
AUTO · reconciling item, no JE, carried forward
notified: none · A-01, A-02

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Internal sweep 50,000 · AUTO
transfer pair, Dr Cash B / Cr Cash A, no P and L
notified: none · A-19

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Descriptor changed, stable key same · AUTO
match via originator id / party
notified: none (decay monitor) · A-09, H-3

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Immaterial one-off variance · AUTO
logged as named open item, no JE, not queued
notified: none · D-09

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Wire net of fee · PROPOSE
match + Dr Bank charges 17.50 / Cr Cash 17.50
notified: controller · A-03

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bank charge, no book entry · PROPOSE
Dr Bank charges 300.00 / Cr Cash 300.00
notified: controller · A-04

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Abbreviated name / spend memo · PROPOSE
match + semantic explanation citing a trace
notified: controller · A-10, A-11

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Many-to-one / one-to-many · PROPOSE
group shown line by line, exact sum
notified: controller · A-05, A-06

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stale check clears · PROPOSE
clear the outstanding item, no JE
notified: controller · A-16

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Refund posted twice (planted) · PROPOSE
reverse the duplicate book entry
Dr Cash / Cr Refunds · notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Processor payout (STRETCH) · PROPOSE
Dr Cash 9,420 + Dr Fees 280 / Cr Clearing 9,700
+ tie-out · controller · A-07, H-2

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two equal candidates · ESCALATE
both shown, none picked, no entry
notified: AP / AR lead · A-18 (A-17 link pair)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bank error / unexplained 12.40 · ESCALATE and
REFUSE to plug · open exception, places-searched
list, bank query draft · controller · A-25, D-10

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Wrong-period half · BLOCK
blocked attempt persisted with rule id,
even if a human approves · notified: close · A-23

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Version check on ingest (input 1, A-24): amended file
arrives later, content hash differs from version_hash
of an already reconciled statement (account, period)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Invalidate dependent groups: every rec group and
workpaper citing a changed line → kernel_verdict
stale, proof no longer signed

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reopen: checklist_item bank rec → blocked
re-run stages 2-7 on affected lines only
emit bankrec.stale

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Amended statement · ESCALATE
rec marked stale, version diff attached
notified: controller, close · A-24, F-06, H-6

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event bus (event table)
topic, from_function=bankrec, intent_id

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bankrec.unmatched
credit → AR cash application
debit → AP (payment or duplicate, A-13)
bankrec.reversal_detected → AR reopen (A-15)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bankrec.reconciled
→ close tie-out (checklist_item bank rec)
→ forecast opening cash

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learnable: alias entries pinned to stable keys
record_fact_candidate(alias) with scope, valid_from,
approved_by → written to the alias table (stage 2)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learnable: fee pattern per bank / counterparty
corridor as a policy, clamped, backtested in replay,
n gte 5 · feeds pass 4 · also coding of bank charges

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Never learned: tolerance widening, a standing plug
tolerance, predicates cut from statement wording
(A-09, G-09), clearing ambiguous pairs from
precedent, anything from one correction (G-05)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Decay monitor: rule hit-rate month over month
drop → alarm, exceptions are not new problems (H-3)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Metrics (TO BE MEASURED, nothing run yet)
lines auto-matched + precision, false auto-posts (0),
unreconciled dollars, open exceptions by age, questions
run 1 vs run 2, model calls per 1,000 lines vs baseline
